name: Mad Labs Disposable | Guava Kush
description: A hybrid celebrated for its tropical forward profile and laid-back effects, pairing a light, happy head buzz with soothing physical ease perfect for chill, end-of-day vibes. Sweet guava and tropical fruit rise upfront, supported by herbal kush notes and a mild earthy-spicy undertone. Offers a calm, uplifting mood shift that settles into warm body relaxation, ideal for easing tension while staying balanced and functional.
